mapper.sql: select base.target_user_id as "targetUserId", base.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", base.final_score as "finalScore", latest_recalc.recalculation_batch_id as "latestRecalculationBatchId", case when latest_recalc.recalculation_batch_id is null then 'MISSING' when coalesce(batch.failure_count, 0) > 0 then 'FAILURE' when coalesce(batch.success_count, 0) > 0 then 'SUCCESS' else 'MISSING' end as "latestRecalculationStatus", coalesce(latest_final.display_status, case when base.confirmed_material_count = base.material_count then 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED' else 'CERTIFIED' end) as "finalStatus", latest_final.confirmed_by as "confirmedBy", latest_final.confirmed_at as "confirmedAt", latest_final.canceled_by as "canceledBy", latest_final.canceled_at as "canceledAt", latest_final.cancel_reason as "cancelReason", latest_final.snapshot_ref as "snapshotRef", base.material_count as "materialCount", base.confirmed_material_count as "confirmedMaterialCount" from ( select em.target_user_id, em.evaluation_year, sum(em.calculated_score) as final_score, count(*)::int as material_count, sum(case when em.material_status = 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED' then 1 else 0 end)::int as confirmed_material_count from evaluation_materials em where em.deleted_yn = 'N' group by em.target_user_id, em.evaluation_year ) base left join lateral ( select scg.recalculation_batch_id, scg.created_at from score_calculation_generations scg join evaluation_materials em2 on em2.evaluation_material_id = scg.evaluation_material_id where em2.target_user_id = base.target_user_id and em2.evaluation_year = base.evaluation_year order by scg.created_at desc, scg.generation_no desc limit 1 ) latest_recalc on true left join evaluation_batch_jobs batch on batch.batch_job_id = latest_recalc.recalculation_batch_id left join lateral ( select ef.final_status, case when ef.final_status = 'CANCELLED' then 'CERTIFIED' else ef.final_status end as display_status, ef.confirmed_by, ef.confirmed_at, ef.canceled_by, ef.canceled_at, ef.cancel_reason, ef.snapshot_ref, ef.created_at from evaluation_finalizations ef where ef.target_user_id = base.target_user_id and ef.evaluation_year = base.evaluation_year order by ef.created_at desc, ef.finalization_id desc limit 1 ) latest_final on true
mapper.select: select em.evaluation_year from evaluation_materials em where em.target_user_id = #{targetUserId} and em.deleted_yn = 'N' order by em.evaluation_year desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_batch_jobs (batch_job_id, batch_type, evaluation_year, target_user_id, target_condition_json, total_count, success_count, failure_count, excluded_count, job_status, requested_by, request_id, created_by, updated_by) values (#{batchJobId}, #{batchType}, #{evaluationYear}, #{targetUserId}, jsonb_build_object('evaluationYear', #{evaluationYear}, 'targetUserId', #{targetUserId}, 'reason', #{reason}), #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{failureCount}, #{excludedCount}, 'COMPLETED', #{requestedBy}, #{requestId}, #{requestedBy}, #{requestedBy})

insert into evaluation_batch_job_items (batch_job_id, target_ref, result_status, error_code, error_message, excluded_reason, request_id, created_by, updated_by) values (#{batchJobId}, #{targetRef}, #{resultStatus}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{excludedReason}, #{requestId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})

insert into evaluation_finalizations (target_user_id, evaluation_year, final_status, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, canceled_by, canceled_at, cancel_reason, snapshot_ref, snapshot_json, finalization_batch_id, request_id, created_by, updated_by) values (#{targetUserId}, #{evaluationYear}, #{finalStatus}, #{confirmedBy}, case when #{finalStatus} = 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED' then now() else null end, #{canceledBy}, case when #{finalStatus} = 'CANCELLED' then now() else null end, #{cancelReason}, #{snapshotRef}, cast(#{snapshotJson} as jsonb), #{batchJobId}, #{requestId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
